lean_statement.text:
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-- Generated from constraint C1 (op `==`). Rescaling base units multiplies both sides by the same factor
    ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 4) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹); so the constraint is invariant. ALL rational values and all nonzero scales. -/
theorem unit_rescaling_invariance_C1 (s_kg s_m s_s : ℚ) (h_kg : s_kg ≠ 0) (h_m : s_m ≠ 0) (h_s : s_s ≠ 0)
    (v_E v_I v_L v_P v_w_C : ℚ) :
    (((3 : ℚ) * (v_E * ((s_kg ^ 1) * (s_m ^ 1 * s_s ^ 2)⁻¹)) * (v_I * ((s_m ^ 4))) * (v_w_C * ((s_m ^ 1)))) = ((v_P * ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 1) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹)) * ((v_L * ((s_m ^ 1))) ^ 3))) ↔ (((3 : ℚ) * v_E * v_I * v_w_C) = (v_P * (v_L ^ 3))) := by
  have hL : ((3 : ℚ) * (v_E * ((s_kg ^ 1) * (s_m ^ 1 * s_s ^ 2)⁻¹)) * (v_I * ((s_m ^ 4))) * (v_w_C * ((s_m ^ 1)))) = ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 4) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹) * ((3 : ℚ) * v_E * v_I * v_w_C) := by
    field_simp <;> ring
  have hR : ((v_P * ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 1) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹)) * ((v_L * ((s_m ^ 1))) ^ 3)) = ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 4) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹) * (v_P * (v_L ^ 3)) := by
    field_simp <;> ring
  have hF : ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 4) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [hL, hR]
  exact mul_right_inj' hF


/-- Generated from constraint C2 (op `==`). Rescaling base units multiplies both sides by the same factor
    ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 3) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹); so the constraint is invariant. ALL rational values and all nonzero scales. -/
theorem unit_rescaling_invariance_C2 (s_kg s_m s_s : ℚ) (h_kg : s_kg ≠ 0) (h_m : s_m ≠ 0) (h_s : s_s ≠ 0)
    (v_B v_E v_I : ℚ) :
    ((v_B * ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 3) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹)) = ((v_E * ((s_kg ^ 1) * (s_m ^ 1 * s_s ^ 2)⁻¹)) * (v_I * ((s_m ^ 4))))) ↔ (v_B = (v_E * v_I)) := by
  have hL : (v_B * ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 3) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹)) = ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 3) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹) * v_B := by
    field_simp <;> ring
  have hR : ((v_E * ((s_kg ^ 1) * (s_m ^ 1 * s_s ^ 2)⁻¹)) * (v_I * ((s_m ^ 4)))) = ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 3) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹) * (v_E * v_I) := by
    field_simp <;> ring
  have hF : ((s_kg ^ 1 * s_m ^ 3) * (s_s ^ 2)⁻¹) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [hL, hR]
  exact mul_right_inj' hF
